anomalies.observed: On the LEDs sheet, the TXS0101DCKR level-shifter U21 has its OE pin (pin 5) tied directly to GND (VCCA pin 1 = +3V3, A pin 3 = NET0162 from CM4 GPIO13, B pin 4 drives the WS2812B DIN chain). With OE held low the device is permanently disabled, so pin 4 stays high-impedance and the GPIO13 data signal never reaches the addressable LEDs.
anomalies.expected: For the WS2812B status-LED data line to work, OE must be tied high (to VCCA/+3V3) so the level shifter is enabled and passes NET0162 through to the LED DIN chain. The spec lists the WS2812B LEDs (D5-D7, D18-D21) as an intended feature of the board.

evidence.quote: LEDs sheet: U21 TXS0101DCKR, pin 5 (OE) connected to GND symbol; pin 1 = +3V3; pin 3 = NET0162; pin 4 = first WS2812B DIN (D34)
Addressable status LEDs (WS2812B, D5-D7, D18-D21) and an analog switch (ISL54222AIUZ, U5) for LED/signal routing.

anomalies.impact: The addressable WS2812B status LED strip receives no data; the LEDs stay off or latch an undefined state, so the board's intended status indication is lost.

parsed.summary: The drawing is largely consistent with the spec (16 MHz CAN crystals, SM712-class TVS, ideal-diode USB path, open-drain e-stop buffers, separate 3.3 V_PI_OUT and +3V3 rails), but the TXS0101 level-shifter U21 that feeds the WS2812B status-LED data line has its OE pin shorted to ground, which permanently disables the level shifter and breaks the addressable-LED feature the spec intends.
